summary: Two-year-old Labrador mix brought to a Lahore clinic with hind-leg lameness after a Model Town park injury.
treatment: TPLO surgery followed by eight weeks of controlled leash rehab. Full weight-bearing restored at week six.
outcome: Discharged fully sound; back to daily fetch at three months. Total cost approx. Rs 145,000.

summary: One-year-old Persian mix in Karachi with straining and blood-tinged urine over three days.
treatment: Catheterisation, IV fluids, pain control, and a switch to a wet urinary diet with added water bowls.
outcome: No recurrence in twelve months of follow-up. Treatment cost approx. Rs 38,000.

summary: Four-year-old rescue in Rawalpindi with fever, lethargy and low platelets during peak tick season.
treatment: Doxycycline course, supportive fluids, and a monthly spot-on tick preventive for the whole household.
outcome: Platelets normalised in three weeks. Owner now follows a year-round tick plan. Cost approx. Rs 22,000.

summary: Mini Lop in Islamabad with reduced appetite, drooling, and weight loss.
treatment: Crown reduction under sedation, syringe feeding for four days, and a permanent hay-first diet.
outcome: Weight regained; burring rechecks every six months. Cost approx. Rs 15,500.
